headline: Iranian leaders fret over public mood as gas shortages add to war ills
summary: Iran's government warned citizens of gas shortages this winter, with its ports blockaded and infrastructure hit by US strikes. Long fuel queues have formed at gasoline stations.
why: Iran is a major oil and gas producer, and disruption to its energy infrastructure and export routes affects regional energy supply and global commodity markets.
